# Agent-Crypto legacy release scripts

Archived on 2026-09-22 after the versioned workflow cleanup.

The active .github/workflows surface references only:
- .github/scripts/agent_crypto_version_truth_guard_compat.py
- .github/scripts/agent_crypto_publish_live_data.sh

All other files formerly under .github/scripts were version-specific release, repair, Aether, Oracle, Strategy, or migration helpers with no reference from the current active workflow set. They are preserved here for source reconstruction and forensic reading.

These archived files are not current release owners. Historical Git commits remain authoritative for exact old paths and executable release state.
